items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And we're having this interview. This is Bill Russell interviewing Mr. French...

ctx.x: And we're having this interview. This is Bill Russell interviewing Mr. French up at his home at 2722 Roberts Street on August 3rd, 1960. Could you tell us just when you were born and where?
I was born in 1910, November 16th, in New Orleans. Right in the city? Right in the city of New Orleans, on Green Street.
